name: Immich Remote ML
description: Standalone native Immich machine-learning service for facial recognition and smart search. Supports NVIDIA CUDA and AMD ROCm GPU passthrough, with a CPU fallback.
notes: In Immich, set the Machine Learning URL to http://<LXC-IP>:3003. The API has no authentication; restrict TCP port 3003 to the Immich server and trusted LAN.

NVIDIA CUDA requires /dev/nvidia* device passthrough and a compatible host driver (Immich requires NVIDIA compute capability 5.2+ and driver 545+). The installer uses the shared helper to install matching NVIDIA userspace libraries; do not install a kernel driver inside the LXC.
AMD ROCm requires AMD GPU passthrough and a compatible Proxmox host driver. For unsupported gfx1030 devices, set HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=10.3.0 in /etc/default/immich-remote-ml.
CUDA and ROCm libraries plus model caches require substantial disk space; the default LXC disk is 50 GiB. CPU backend is selected when no supported GPU is detected.
